canvas_grammar.description: Chat360 voice bot canvas — node-based visual flow builder. All node types, fields, and rules derived from production bots.

INIT.description: Start of every bot flow. No TTS, no input. Routes to first real node.
rules: Exactly one INIT per bot
routing_table.default → first VOICE_GENAI or VOICE_CUSTOM_INPUT

VOICE_GENAI.description: LLM-powered conversational node. Bot thinks and responds here. Core of every flow.
rules: prompt = full LLM system instruction. MUST include: 'Respond exclusively in @bot_language — overrides all other instructions.'
initial_message = bot opening spoken line on first entry to this node
genai_response_variable stores LLM output (e.g. @genairesponse)
routing_table.default = next node UUID; null ends the call
skip_speak=true → silent processing, no TTS output
skip_listen=true → no wait for caller speech input
use_tools=true → enables function/tool calling
rag=true → enables knowledge base retrieval
For multi-specialist architectures: each specialist gets its own VOICE_GENAI with a domain-specific system prompt

VOICE_CUSTOM_INPUT.description: Speaks TTS then captures caller speech. Used for listen-respond loops with VOICE_GENAI.
rules: tts_prompt = what bot says before listening (can use @variable)
response_variable = stores caller speech (e.g. @query)
Typically loops back to VOICE_GENAI for LLM processing
error_retry_count = retries on silence before fallback

VOICE_MESSAGE.description: One-way TTS. Bot speaks, no input captured. Confirmations, goodbyes, agent transfers.
rules: No caller input
routing_table.default → next node or null to end call

VOICE_INTENT.description: Detects a specific intent from caller speech and routes to a named output port. Core of multi-specialist routing.
VOICE_INTENT.ports: one in, one Default out, one named out per intent
rules: intents = array of intent IDs to watch for
routing_table: {default: fallthrough_node, <intent_id>: specialist_node_uuid}
portOpt: one named port per intent — label is human-readable intent name
Default port = no intent matched, falls through to next handler
Used to build multi-specialist flows: one VOICE_INTENT per domain boundary

VOICE_SET_VARIABLE.description: Hardcodes a runtime variable value. Used to track conversation state.
rules: variable = @variable_name to set
value = literal string to assign
Use to set: @category_intent, @subcategory_intent, @lead_status, @vehicle_interest

VOICE_CONDITIONAL.description: Multi-branch if/else routing based on variable values. Supports EQUALS_TO and CONTAINS conditions.
VOICE_CONDITIONAL.ports: one in, one Default out, one named out per condition value
rules: conditions = array of {variable, value, condition: EQUALS_TO|CONTAINS}
routing_table: {default: node, <matched_value_lowercase>: node, ...}
portOpt: one named port per condition branch + Default
Can handle up to 12+ branches (e.g. routing by city/airport)
Use for: CRM status branching, lead quality routing, city/region routing

VOICE_WEBHOOK.description: HTTP GET or POST to an external or Chat360 API. Captures structured response into @variables.
rules: url can use @variable substitution in query_params
response_body_schema = JSON array mapping response fields → @variables
capture_response=true to store response
Use at flow start to fetch CRM/lead data by @caller_number
Chat360 CRM endpoint pattern: /api/<client>/fetch_crm?mobilePhone=@caller_number

VOICE_MULTI_CHOICE.description: Presents a spoken list of options. Caller selects one. Stores choice in option_variable.
VOICE_MULTI_CHOICE.ports: one in, one Default out, Error out
rules: multichoice_options = array of string options
option_variable = @variable to store selected option
Error port for invalid/no selection
Use for: menu selection, city/region selection, product category

VOICE_LANGUAGE_PREFERENCE.description: Caller selects preferred language. Sets @bot_language for entire downstream flow.
rules: Place early in flow — before first VOICE_GENAI if multilingual
Sets @bot_language which all VOICE_GENAI prompts MUST reference

canvas_grammar.routing_table_format: {"default": "<uuid>"} for single-path nodes; {"default": "<uuid>", "<branch_key>": "<uuid>"} for multi-branch nodes. null target = call ends.

common.@caller_number: Inbound caller phone number (auto-populated by platform)

bot_level_config.outbound_params: Array of @variable names injected from campaign CSV at call start

proven_prompt_patterns: Language rule (REQUIRED in every prompt): 'Respond exclusively in @bot_language. This rule overrides all other instructions.'
No symbols (voice only): 'Never use bullet points, numbered lists, or special characters — spoken responses only.'
Outbound opener: 'Good morning, I am [Name] calling from [Company]. Am I speaking with [CustomerName]?'
Concise: 'Keep all responses under 2 sentences. No filler phrases.'
Qualification flow: Confirm identity → check availability → qualify intent → handle objection → book/transfer/schedule callback
Objection handling: 'Acknowledge the objection in one sentence, then redirect to value proposition.'
Silence handling: Include retry_prompt in bot_level silence_handle_config — e.g. 'Hello, are you still there?'
